text:
maria_sales: Heads-up — Keystone Labs POC is blocked by governance signoff. CISO flagged three blockers: BYOK/KMS attestation, SSO/OIDC flow, and egress to their internal CRM. They want an exec touchpoint.

jordan_se: TL;DR from their call: they need BYOK + OIDC SSO, IP allowlist for egress, and legal wants the full Vendor Security Assessment answered. Also asked for committed latency SLA during the pilot.

sam_eng_infra: We can support BYOK (KMS ARN + role), and OIDC SSO, but HSM attestation is extra. Network-wise we can add static egress w/ IP allowlist but we need a CIDR list and an approximate traffic profile. ETA to validate setup and run a perf test: 48 hours.

lee_legal: They've uploaded a Vendor Security Assessment v3 with several redlines (esp around backups & logging retention). I'm drafting a redline response now — will flag the truly non-starters.

harper_cs: Customer also wants a POC discount and a short SLA for p95 latency under load. We have benchmark numbers from staging but not an agreement-level SLA for trials. Asking: what's their expected qps?

maria_sales: They specified target: 15 qps, p95 < 500ms. Also asked if we can do a 3-month pilot with a discounted rate. Need internal decision on discount band and whether to provide an SLA doc for the pilot.

sam_eng_infra: I'll queue a synthetic load from eu-west-1 tomorrow morning and post results + artifact. Command I'm going to use:```hey-bench --target keystone-demo --qps 15 --concurrency 8 --duration 300```Will need the test endpoint & an allowlist rule to run at scale.

jordan_se: Action items (quick):
- sam_eng_infra: perf test + test artifacts (due +1 day)
- lee_legal: redlined security assessment + list of non-negotiables (due +2 days)
- maria_sales: set up CTO exec sync for Friday (invite out)
- harper_cs: share sample pilot SLA + runbook (today)
- vp_sales: approve POC discount floor (urgent)

maria_sales: @vp_sales please advise on discount floor — customer pushing for 35–50% pilot discount.

vp_sales: We can approve up to 40% discount for a 3-month pilot if commit >= $25k ARR equivalent and we get a clear success criteria doc. Anything above needs CRO signoff. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Note: created internal tracker ticket POC-1234 and linked security questionnaire.

maria_sales: Copy — I'll update the tracker and send the CTO invite after sam confirms perf test window. Thanks all :) :thumbsup:
